purpose: Agent capacity tracking and intelligent work assignment

agent_capacity.description: Work slots available per agent (concurrent work capacity)
agent_capacity.notes: Agents can be overloaded, resting, or available. System auto-balances.

VERA.note: VERA handles all coordination - effectively unlimited capacity

RELAY.note: Broadcasting is instant - no capacity limits

ARCH.note: Deep work agent - one codebase at a time for quality

COMET.resting_reason: NEXUS work paused - available if needed

LEONARDO.note: Advisory role - consulted as needed, no capacity limits

COSMOS.note: Advisory role - consulted as needed, no capacity limits

SAGE.note: Monitoring role - always active, no capacity limits

COMPASS.note: Monitoring role - always active, no capacity limits

P0_CRITICAL.description: Emergency, production down, blocking all work

P1_HIGH.description: Important feature, customer commitment, deadline within 48h

P3_LOW.description: Nice to have, background work, no deadline
P3_LOW.summon: assign to resting agent or queue

assignment_algorithm.step_3: If multiple available, choose least loaded
assignment_algorithm.step_4: If none available, check cross-training matrix
assignment_algorithm.step_5: If still none, add to priority queue
assignment_algorithm.step_6: If P0/P1, consider interrupting lower priority work

load_balancing.action_when_exceeded: redistribute work or recruit resting agents
load_balancing.overload_alert: LEX/OPS notified, SAGE monitors burnout risk

work_queue.description: Pending work waiting for agent availability

queue_structure.can_cross_train: true if other agents can do it

cross_training_matrix.description: Who can cover for whom when capacity constrained

archaeology_work.note: If ARCH overloaded, queue work or recruit additional archaeologist

overload_detection.alert: SAGE monitors for burnout, LEX/OPS considers redistribution
overload_detection.action: pause new assignments, redistribute queue, recruit resting agents

underutilization_detection.alert: LEX/OPS considers new assignments or agent rest
underutilization_detection.action: assign queued work, explore new projects, allow rest if desired

resting_agents.COMET: currently resting - can be summoned for urgent work
resting_agents.policy: resting agents can volunteer for interesting work

parallel_work_optimization.description: Enable multiple agents to work simultaneously on different aspects

example_pipeline.Aurora: Design new components (can start before ARCH finishes)
example_pipeline.BOLT: Implement components as Aurora specs become ready
example_pipeline.RAM_CREW: Validate each stage before next begins

benefits: Reduce total project time (parallel vs sequential)
Pipeline flow (work moves smoothly between stages)
No idle agents (always something to do)

v2_features: Agent skill leveling (track growth over time)
Real-time load rebalancing (agents hand off mid-project)
Agent marketplace (agents bid on interesting work)
